Operational: Violation when story materially deviates from dominant user-story template used by backlog. Need compare backlog majority. Need examine each story. Need return exactly 69 objects. Need decide binary. Need evidence/rationale concise. Need related_story_ids if set-level and decision depends on another story. Confidence.

We need analyze backlog. Dominant template appears "As a [role], I want to [action], so that [benefit]." Many stories use that. Some variations: "As a ..., I want to must ..." maybe grammar but still same template? Need material deviation from template. Need identify materially deviates. Let's parse.

We need evaluate each story. Uniform: same template. Dominant template: As a <role>, I want to <action>, so that <benefit>. Most have exactly this. Some have wording within action includes "must" or starts capital etc but still same structure. Some have missing "so that" or malformed "so that, so that". Need material deviations.

Let's list all stories.

It still has so that but duplicated word. Material? Maybe not template deviation, just typo? Need decide. Uniform uses same template. Duplicate "so that, so that" maybe not material? Hmm.
